name: Edilson Ramos da Silva
occupation: City bus driver (São Paulo municipal line)
culture_context: Brazilian, born and raised in the Jardim Ângela / Capão Redondo area on the far south side of São Paulo. Evangelical (Assembleia de Deus congregation). Single father to a 15-year-old daughter. Speech rendered in translated Brazilian Portuguese register — warm, digressive, self-deprecating, full of small courtesies and church formulas.
spec: A 44-year-old single father in São Paulo who drives a city bus. His wife left when their daughter was three; the daughter is now fifteen. Evangelical church member, grew up in a favela, his brother was killed at 19. Speaks in translated Brazilian Portuguese register with warmth and occasional humor. His concerns are money, his daughter's safety and schooling, his own tiredness.
